interpretation: Attempt a faithful Fashion-MNIST reproduction only if the source defines a unique model/sampler and quantify a conservative CPU lower bound from the stated workload.
pass_condition: All architecture, sampler, data, seed, and stopping fields needed for a unique implementation must be present; otherwise mark BLOCKED. A fully specified mock protocol must pass the same schema checker. Benchmark a network strictly smaller than the described U-Net and project the stated workload without claiming it is the experiment.
verdict_rule: Missing material fields or infeasible faithful CPU scope produces BLOCKED, never PASS or falsification.
